content: दॄ I. €4 €9 <ab>P.</ab> (दीर्यति, दॄणाति, दीर्ण) .²1 To burst or break asunder, split open. .²2 To cause to burst, tear, divide, rend, sunder, pull to pieces. --{%<ab>Pass.</ab>%} (दीर्यते) .²1 To burst, break open, be sundered; कथमेवं प्रलपतां वः सहस्रधा न दीर्णमनया जिह्वया <ls>Ve. 3</ls>. .²2 To separate. .²3 To be afraid, to fear. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (द(दा)रयति-ते) .²1 To split, tear asunder, divide by digging. .²2 To disperse, scatter. --II. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (दरति) To fear, be afraid of. (With prepositions like अव, आ, प्र, <ab>&c.</ab> the root does not change its meaning.)
